title: OSM - FinnPherb
description: This is the Official Stream Modpack (OSM) compiled by FinnPherb. It's a collection of the mods I use on stream. "I... Am Steve"
body:
# FinnPherb Official Modpack

## This is the Modpack that I use on my streams and SMP- the FinnPherb SMP.

If you want to use the mod collection on my SMP, hop on stream sometime!

- [https://www.youtube.com/@FinnPherb](https://www.youtube.com/@FinnPherb)

- [https://www.twitch.tv/finnpherb](https://www.twitch.tv/finnpherb)

## I love using these mods, and you can enjoy them now too!

_I have been asked quite a bit to make the mods that I use into a modpack._


### Resource packs and shaders...

**They aren't included in the modpack, but you can find them here:**
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/enchant-icons-countxd](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/enchant-icons-countxd)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-crops](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-crops)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fat-cat](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fat-cat)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mob-crates](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mob-crates)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/recolourful-containers-gui](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/recolourful-containers-gui)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/simple-grass-flowers](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/simple-grass-flowers)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/sus-sand](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/sus-sand)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tras-fresh-player](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tras-fresh-player)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/animated-items](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/animated-items)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/assorted-allays-x-fresh-animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/assorted-allays-x-fresh-animations)
- [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/banner-pattern-clarity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/banner-pattern-clarity)
- [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/armorstands-reimagined](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/armorstands-reimagined)
- [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/creeper-overhaul](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/creeper-overhaul)
- [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/better-zombies-x-fresh-animations](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/better-zombies-x-fresh-animations)

Note: Not in that specific load order, find what you prefer :D






### I hope you enjoy!



_DISCLAIMER:
I would recommend not using this modpack on servers like Hypixel, PVP Legacy, etc. As some mods that are included may be considered as an 'unfair advantage' (e.g "Xaero's Minimap")_
